parent_objective: repair M261 raw protected-key source regression without running PPO

public_gates: trajectory-anchored protected-source projection from M261 raw
exact source gate versus M261 base
interpolation from M261 base to repaired projection
row16 gate before full public gates
full public replay and behavior gates
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M263
do not skip exact-source or row16 gates
do not tune from private holdout evidence
hypothesis: A trajectory-anchored protected-source projection can repair M261 raw PPO's protected-key source regression and admit a larger proof-safe update than M261 alpha 0.001.
success_criteria: projection completes from M261 raw without actor input changes
projected checkpoint improves protected-key source and M223 source relative to M261 base or admits an interpolation candidate that does
selected interpolation candidate passes exact-source tolerance versus M261 base
selected candidate passes full public replay, protected-key, and behavior gates
failure_criteria: projection cannot repair protected-key source without breaking M223 source
all exact-gated interpolation candidates fail row16 or protected key
selected candidate fails broader public replay or behavior gates

commands.name: m263_projection_repair
commands.command: Run outcome_intervention_optimize from M261 raw with M232 snippets and M235 trajectory anchor, then interpolation-gate against M261 base.

decision_rule: M263 may only promote a checkpoint if a repaired or interpolated candidate improves exact sources versus M261 and passes row16, protected-key, full public replay, behavior, and validator gates.
next_blocker: If M263 succeeds, repeat the repair path or design a cautious medium-PPO escalation; if it fails, redesign protected-source PPO pressure before more continuation.
